title: Todo List SPA
summary: A single‑page app for managing personal tasks.
details: Build a vanilla‑JS (or React/Vue) todo list with add, edit, delete, and filter (all/active/completed). Persist data in localStorage so the list survives page reloads.

title: Weather Dashboard
summary: Show current weather and a 5‑day forecast for any city.
details: Consume a public weather API (e.g., OpenWeatherMap). Display temperature, humidity, wind speed, and an icon. Include a search box and store recent searches in localStorage.

title: Markdown Previewer
summary: Live preview of markdown text as HTML.
details: Create a split‑view interface where the left pane is a textarea for markdown input and the right pane renders the parsed HTML in real time. Use a library like marked.js or showdown.

title: Currency Converter
summary: Convert amounts between major world currencies.
details: Fetch exchange rates from a free API (e.g., exchangerate.host). Allow the user to select source and target currencies and enter an amount. Show the converted value instantly.

title: Quiz App
summary: A multiple‑choice trivia game with scoring.
details: Pull a set of questions from the Open Trivia DB API or hard‑code a small pool. Randomize question order, track correct answers, and display a final score with a restart button.

title: Personal Portfolio Site
summary: Static site showcasing your bio, projects, and contact info.
details: Build a responsive, single‑page portfolio using HTML/CSS (Flexbox/Grid) and a touch of JavaScript for smooth scrolling or a light‑box gallery. Deploy to GitHub Pages or Netlify.

title: Chat Widget (Mock)
summary: A simple front‑end chat interface that echoes user messages.
details: Create a UI with a message list and input box. When the user sends a message, display it and immediately show a bot reply like “You said: …”. No backend required—just practice DOM manipulation and event handling.

title: Expense Tracker
summary: Track daily expenses and visualize totals.
details: Allow users to add expense entries (amount, category, date). Store data in localStorage. Show a running total and a simple bar chart (e.g., Chart.js) summarizing spending per category.

title: URL Shortener Front‑End
summary: Interface for creating short URLs via a public API.
details: Integrate with a free shortening service (e.g., shrtco.de). User enters a long URL, clicks “Shorten”, and sees the shortened link with a copy‑to‑clipboard button.

title: Memory Game
summary: Classic card‑matching game with a timer.
details: Generate a grid of paired cards (icons or emojis). Flip cards on click, detect matches, and count moves. End the game when all pairs are found and display the elapsed time.
